scope: First capability-expedition loop; observations and participant interpretations are separate.

events.event: Brainstorming through existing Browser Medium conversation
events.interpretation: Common workpieces, optional projections, native repo actions and consumer choice were compared; no architecture decision.
Consumer agency, including informed no-change, retained; surprise not required.

events.event: Browser authored and published a workpiece
Codex selected a complete declared-source check and new optional projection
Second fresh-reader attempt did not complete
events.status: Usage-limit error; no completed reader report
Current ordinary use permitted; original assignment resumed without changing its question or erasing the failed attempt
events.privacy_boundary: No account identifiers, usage percentages, reset credits or private UI screenshots included

events.event: Public artifact request delivered to Browser

evidence.thread_readback: A completed turn containing a userMessage only, with no assistant output at that observation

evidence.ui_observation: New request visible; active generation control visible after reopening

events.causality_boundary: No claim that reopening alone caused execution, or that the earlier thread read proved a transport defect

events.event: Browser consumed published artifact and selected a new identity-edge check
events.selected_non_action: No new Medium primitive or schema change; current distinct handles suffice

events.event: Resumed fresh reader completed a bounded partial report
events.status: Independent source-wrapper and renderer hashes match; full current projection and original seven-source recheck unresolved

events.event: Input-drift correction after reading the completed report
events.status: Earlier local Markdown acquisition was 4583 bytes; published exact-comment Markdown is 4582 bytes. Fully frozen-input claim withdrawn.

events.event: Full participant text exposed a donor display failure
events.status: Reproduced and diagnosed; note text had normal wrapping for long tokens

events.event: One CSS rule adapted the isolated donor copy
events.status: Mobile width now 390; raw packages remain exact; historical source and donor branch not changed

events.event: A consumer freely selected and reused an existing procedure
events.status: Completed one own unresolved byte-correspondence check with fresh observed preview data; no new library or infrastructure
events.method_boundary: Separate execution using a shared procedure; not an independently implemented reference algorithm

candidate_learning: In this specimen, delivery, visible execution and externally recoverable output require distinct observations. A successful send receipt is not itself an artifact-consumption receipt.
boundaries: Operational observations of this run, not a general specification of OpenAI transport semantics
No new message bus, scheduling service or automated retry system
Browser is an already familiar participant; its use cannot replace the fresh-reader condition
